target_customer: US consumers who take vitamins and supplements and want a personalized monthly pack
problem: People buy vitamins in bulk bottles at retailers without personalization or convenience; Zenamins mailed a personalized pack of daily doses every four weeks.
business_model: Consumer subscription, about 30 dollars a month for a three pill a day regimen

founders.name: Arad Rostampour
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch 2014-08-18 calls him a Stanford and Wharton graduate; SocialShield raised 10 million dollars. Degrees not specified.

competitors.name: GNC
competitors.traction_then: Named by the founder as an incumbent; pricing similar to Zenamins at about 30 dollars a month

competitors.name: The Vitamin Shoppe
competitors.traction_then: Named by TechCrunch as a long standing seller in a 32 billion dollar a year market

competitors.name: Nature Made
competitors.traction_then: Named by TechCrunch as a long standing seller

technical_complexity.rationale: A subscription store with a vitamin selection guide and outsourced pharmacy grade pack assembly; logistics and compliance mattered more than software.

defensibility.rationale: No proprietary product or data; the founder himself warned large brands launching customized packs would have a huge impact.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: GNC launched a personalized vitamin pack subscription in October 2019 and Vitamin Shoppe launched Only Me in September 2019, per later trade press seen in search; Care/of entered with 3 million dollars seed in 2016.

market_need_then: TechCrunch (2014-08-18) cited a 32 billion dollar a year vitamin market and the founder's view that personalization was missing; no customer or revenue figures were published.

branding.domain_note: Used zenamins.com, which returned an error (HTTP 526) when fetched; the parent entity was called Zen Health.

identity.voice_and_tone: Wellness and convenience framing from the YC description: personalized, pharmacy grade, softgels.

branding.community_and_virality: Covered by TechCrunch (2014-08-18) and a Product Hunt listing; no merch or community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Zen plus vitamins is easy to understand but the spelling is unusual, and press was a single launch article.

outcome_analysis: Zenamins launched a personalized vitamin pack subscription at the YC Summer 2014 demo day with a founder who had sold SocialShield to Avira, and the last press mention found is May 2015. Only a database reports a tiny 20 thousand dollar seed. A user generated directory says it struggled to gain traction and closed, but that is unverified and no company statement was found, so the cause of the shutdown is not public and no failure factors are assigned.
notes: The round rests on a single database (CB Insights), which also says total raised 20K over 3 rounds, so two rounds are unidentified; Seedtable shows no rounds. The loot-drop closure claim is a weak aggregator and unverified. CB Insights lists SocialShield and HPE as prior work, not confirmed by an opened press source. Care/of results in searches are a different later company. Company site returned HTTP 526.
